classes.name: Ford Warden
classes.subtitle: Shield and blade
classes.description: A river-crossing guard: shield up, feet planted, nobody gets past the ferry rope.

classFeatures.name: Hold the Rope
classFeatures.desc: +2 Armour Class while you carry a shield.

classFeatures.name: Shield Bash
classFeatures.desc: Slam your foe: 1d4 damage and it loses its next attack (once per fight, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Second Wind
classFeatures.desc: Catch your breath mid-fight: heal 2d4+2 (once per fight, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Fen Tracker
classes.subtitle: Bow and patience
classes.description: Raised in the reeds. Reads tracks like print and shoots from where nobody is looking.

classFeatures.name: Reed Sense
classFeatures.desc: +2 on Tracking and Survival checks, +1 to hit with ranged weapons.

classFeatures.name: Pinning Shot
classFeatures.desc: A shot at +2 to hit that pins your foe in place (entangled, 2 rounds; once per fight, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Fogwalker
classFeatures.desc: You see well in fog and dark: night and weather never blind you.

classes.name: Guild Tinker
classes.subtitle: Picks, powders and patience
classes.description: The Guild's lock-and-gadget specialist. Opens what is shut and makes what is missing.

classFeatures.name: Light Fingers
classFeatures.desc: +3 on lockpicking and pickpocketing; your picks never snap.

classFeatures.name: Flash Powder
classFeatures.desc: A pinch of powder in the eyes: your foe is confused for 2 rounds (once per fight, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Field Engineer
classFeatures.desc: Traps never catch you, and you spot weak points (+1 damage).
